fields.Name: T100 - Query Required Parameters
fields.Description: Verifies the Queries UI surfaces required input parameters before a query can return data.

InputDefinition.goal: In Data Explorer > Queries, use the LEFT sidebar 'Search queries...' box (NOT the global Ctrl+K box) to find a query that requires input parameters: type 'Recent Entity Changes' (or 'Tag Distribution For Entity') and select it. Verify its Query Parameters panel appears with one or more fields marked with a red asterisk (*), indicating input is required before results are returned (the grid shows no results until a parameter is supplied). If neither named query is present, pick any query whose selection reveals a Query Parameters panel with asterisked required field(s). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A query requiring parameters was selected
A Query Parameters panel with a required field (red asterisk) is shown
No results are returned until the required parameter is provided
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
